mapper.insert: INSERT INTO profile_snapshot (id, student_id, source_version, dimension_json, summary, strengths_json, explore_json, feedback_json, version_no, completeness) VALUES (#{id}, #{studentId}, #{sourceVersion}, #{dimensionJson}, #{summary}, #{strengthsJson}, #{exploreJson}, #{feedbackJson}, #{versionNo}, #{completeness})
mapper.select: SELECT id, student_id, source_version, dimension_json, summary, strengths_json, explore_json, feedback_json, version_no, completeness, created_at FROM profile_snapshot WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, student_id, source_version, dimension_json, summary, strengths_json, explore_json, feedback_json, version_no, completeness, created_at FROM profile_snapshot WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, student_id, source_version, dimension_json, summary, strengths_json, explore_json, feedback_json, version_no, completeness, created_at FROM profile_snapshot WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC, created_at DESC
